prompt: Monks' cells built into the cliff face above the sea.

card.name: Cliffside Monastery

site.text: Monks' cells built into the cliff face above the sea

style.text: Austere carved stone, simple monastic look, lantern light, weathered by sea wind

purpose.text: A monastery of monks living and praying in cells cut into the cliff

card.interpretation: You described monks' cells carved into a sea cliff. I took the site as a cliff face over the water, the style as austere carved stone, and the purpose as a monastery. The program is a small, sparse set of buildings: cells on ledges, a chapel, refectory, scriptorium, bell tower and a landing.
assumptions: Size S/M: about 10 buildings is too many for a small cliff, so kept to a compact set
Style was not specified; chose austere weathered stone
Existing cliff terrain is used rather than sculpted
Density low to suit a quiet monastery

program.notes: Largest hall, carved into the cliff at its heart with a window facing the sea
Small rooms cut into the rock face on ledges, each with a bed, lectern and sea window
Shared dining hall with kitchen, near the chapel
Bookshelves, lecterns and lanterns for copying manuscripts
Atop the cliff, overlooking the sea
Small landing at the cliff foot reached by a carved stair
